lines.text: The prayer asks the LORD to come down so the seas quake and the nations tremble at His presence.

problems.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "His enemies" isn't in Isaiah 64:2 word for word.
"the Philistines" and "His enemies" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
